title: LocalCop: An R package for local likelihood inference for conditional copulas
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures; submitted to the Journal of Open Source Software (JOSS)
abstract: Conditional copulas models allow the dependence structure between multiple response variables to be modelled as a function of covariates. LocalCop (Acar & Lysy, 2024) is an R/C++ package for computationally efficient semiparametric conditional copula modelling using a local likelihood inference framework developed in Acar, Craiu, & Yao (2011), Acar, Craiu, & Yao (2013) and Acar, Czado, & Lysy (2019).
